Maine order ID **ORD-22010** check kiya hai. BlueDart ke tracking ke mutabiq iski delivery date 8 October 2026 dikha rahi hai, lekin aapne same-day delivery ke extra charges diye hain aur aapko dawaai aaj hi chahiye. 

Aapki urgent situation ko dekhte hue main ise turant escalate kar raha hoon taaki hamari delivery team aapse contact kare aur aaj hi delivery ensure kar sake. Kripya thoda intezaar karein.
